adambee1234567: The old hands of V-F19 have been here since Day 1. Henrik "Mud" Adambee has been here since Day 12. In a trench, that difference already feels like years.
A bullet hit the sandbag beside Henrik "Mud" Adambee. He ducked, and noticed his hands were shaking. He kept working anyway.
Henrik "Mud" Adambee tried to dry a page near the stove. The paper survived, but the message now has the smell of toasted bread.

A borrowed pencil wore down while Henrik "Mud" Adambee was writing home. The last line is twice as large as the first. Henrik "Mud" Adambee reported for duty as a sapper. The new kit was heavier than the explanation of how to use it.
Henrik "Mud" Adambee sharpened a pencil carefully and then could not think what to write. He put the date at the top anyway.
countdooku04: By the time Tobias Countdooku reached P-F18, the war was 11 days old and had its own habits. He learned the first one within the hour: keep your head down. The report confirmed the Hegemony victory at Grey Mill. Tobias Countdooku folded the paper so the headline stayed on the outside.

Tobias Countdooku warmed the ink bottle inside his tunic. The letter began only when the ink agreed to move. Tobias Countdooku bought War Bonds for the front. The quartermaster pinned the ribbon on personally: 'The front remembers who kept it fed.' Tobias Countdooku was invited to the Officers' Mess for keeping the front supplied. The colonel poured a real coffee and raised his cup: 'The front does not forget its friends.' A border collie wandered in from no man's land at dawn, wet and hungry. It chose Tobias Countdooku. Tobias Countdooku gave it a name: Rosie.

Tobias Countdooku watched a pale shape beyond the wire while a flare burned out. It turned out to be a sack, right where the sack had always been. A soldier from another squad offered three cigarettes for Rosie. Tobias Countdooku said no. The dog is not for sale. A letter from home reached Tobias Countdooku before dusk. Tobias Countdooku read it twice and slept a little easier.

Tobias Countdooku taught a recruit to recognize letters by sound. By supper, the whole table was tapping out Morse on the planks. A letter from home reached Tobias Countdooku before dusk. Tobias Countdooku read it twice and slept a little easier. Tobias Countdooku reported for duty as a rifleman. The new kit was heavier than the explanation of how to use it.

Tobias Countdooku rested the rifle on a sandbag, breathed out, and squeezed. Florian "Ash" Rybilton was gravely wounded at the far edge of no man's land. A bullet struck Tobias Countdooku below the ribs at P-F18. He kept asking whether the post was still manned until the bearers took him away. Shot by Oskar Kha of the Concord (@niko2kha). Tobias Countdooku was hit at P-F18 and died before the medic arrived. The squad has kept his place on the fire step empty. Shot by Oskar Kha of the Concord (@niko2kha).

Another member of the House of Countdooku reached the line: Roland "Mole" Countdooku. He asked where Tobias Countdooku had slept, then chose a different corner. Rosie the border collie was waiting at the end of the trench. It sniffed Roland "Mole" Countdooku for a long time, then lay down at his feet. It stays with the family.

In the dark of the Concord trench Roland "Mole" Countdooku hit Benedikt Theoneonlyfi with a trench club, then ran for the wire before the flares went up. (@theoneonlyfishboy) The raid hit the Concord line at the darkest hour. Roland "Mole" Countdooku fought Edmund Thegremillio in a trench no wider than a door. Roland "Mole" Countdooku came home with Edmund Thegremillio's cap badge. (@thegremillionair) The letter for Roland "Mole" Countdooku ended with 'come home soon'. Roland "Mole" Countdooku read the last line more than the rest.
halohuston: By the time Teodor "Mud" Halohuston reached T-F4, the war was 9 days old and had its own habits. He learned the first one within the hour: keep your head down.

The raid was quick, the way back was not. Teodor "Mud" Halohuston snagged on the wire and took a bullet before the others pulled Teodor "Mud" Halohuston free. The orderlies scrubbed a bed in the hospital dugout and called for Teodor "Mud" Halohuston. He was asleep before they set him down. Teodor "Mud" Halohuston ate a whole bowl of soup today. The surgeon says that is better than any medicine. From Blackwater Canal the Hegemony guns have a clear view. Teodor "Mud" Halohuston wrote to five brothers, all on other fronts that night and said only: 'We will take it back.'

Another quiet day in the ward for Teodor "Mud" Halohuston. He counted the cracks in the ceiling and got to forty-one. News of the loss of Grey Mill reached T-F4 with the rations. Teodor "Mud" Halohuston ate while listening to the revised orders.
Teodor "Mud" Halohuston returned to T-F4 thinner and paler, with a wound that closed without a single night in a bed. The medics count it as one of theirs.
A round went through the rim of Teodor "Mud" Halohuston's helmet and nicked his ear on the way out. He has a notch in both now. Shot by Matthias Cheese of the Hegemony (@meme4cheese).
Three days with a bandage, and Teodor "Mud" Halohuston is back at T-F4. He says the food at the aid post was worse than the food in the trench. Nobody believes him.
Teodor "Mud" Halohuston wrote a letter home. He wrote about the weather. He did not write about the rats.
The telephone wire to T-F4 was cut by shelling four times. Teodor "Mud" Halohuston crawled out and spliced it four times.
jerebearmorrison: They issued Silas "Hollow" Jerebearmorr a rifle, a spade and a number. He kept a pocket Bible with a hole in it in his breast pocket, where the shrapnel would have to go through it first.

Silas "Hollow" Jerebearmorr went in with a pistol and a trench club. In the Hegemony trench Clement Jewnipers put up a fight, but not for long. (@jewnipers) Day 10. Blackwater Canal fell to the Hegemony. Silas "Hollow" Jerebearmorr watched their flag go up on the heights and dug his trench a little deeper.

Silas "Hollow" Jerebearmorr had just lit a cigarette at R-R13 when a bullet cut a line across his cheek. He finished the cigarette before going to the medic. Shot by Teodor Dritte of the Hegemony (@jones.der.dritte). The clerk counted the names twice. Silas "Hollow" Jerebearmorr is number 909 of the first thousand to answer the call, and wears the ribbon of the First Thousand. The Hegemony hold Grey Mill now, and they can see straight into R-R13. Silas "Hollow" Jerebearmorr has learned to walk bent double.
The medics cleaned Silas "Hollow" Jerebearmorr's wound one last time and pronounced him fit. He is back to full duty at R-R13.
Silas "Hollow" Jerebearmorr counted the stitches in a darned sock while waiting for orders. Whoever fixed it had used three colors of wool.
On a quiet night Silas "Hollow" Jerebearmorr (Concord) and Zeno Vpadlu (Hegemony) called out their names across no man's land, just to hear another voice. Now each knows exactly who is out there.
Silas "Hollow" Jerebearmorr mended a split glove with pale thread. One finger now looks like it has been promoted.
A round went through Silas "Hollow" Jerebearmorr's water bottle and into his thigh, but not far. He is more upset about the water. Shot by Florian Joshbanaka of the Hegemony (@joshbanaka).
lettersuponashes: The draft reached R-S1 on Day 9. Nils Lettersupona was shown which board tipped, which roof leaked and which promises to ignore.

Nils Lettersupona was hit in the hand while passing a mug along the trench at R-S1. He did not spill a drop. The men are still talking about that. Shot by Arno Luisskiks of the Concord (@luisskiks). The report confirmed the Hegemony victory at Blackwater Canal. Nils Lettersupona folded the paper so the headline stayed on the outside.

The medic looked at Nils Lettersupona's wound, sniffed it, and sent him back to R-S1. Clean, said the medic. It is the best word a medic knows. A thousand names now stand in the regimental book. Nils Lettersupona is number 636. The sergeant pinned the ribbon of the First Thousand on without a speech. The Hegemony flag went up over Grey Mill. Nils Lettersupona did not cheer. He sat down on a sandbag and ate his ration slowly, like a man with time again.
On dawn watch at R-S1, Nils Lettersupona fired at a shadow by the enemy wire. The shadow was Nils Man, now grazed.
Nils Lettersupona began a chess game by post with a friend at home. He copied the opening move onto the corner of an ordinary letter.
The reply to Nils Lettersupona's chess move arrived with a long complaint about the weather at home and a note that his opponent had taken a pawn.
Nils Lettersupona turned a year older today. The whole squad sang for him, badly, and the cook found a candle.
Nils Lettersupona asked the dugout for advice on the next move. Three men disagreed so fiercely that a second board had to be drawn.
pbscn_: Oskar Pbscn reported to S-F11 with a key to a house that is no longer there sewn into his tunic lining. The sergeant pretended not to notice.
Oskar Pbscn was in the first hundred. The old hands in S-F11 call them 'the early birds', and not always kindly.

Oskar Pbscn waited at the fire step while a flare burned out. The pale shape beyond the wire resolved into a sack, exactly where the sack had always been. Word came down the line: Verdel Ridge is ours. Oskar Pbscn shook hands with a corporal he had never spoken to. Today, everyone was a friend.
Oskar Pbscn stood at the parapet at dawn with the rest of S-F11, bayonet fixed, staring into the grey. Nothing came. Nothing came yesterday, either.
A borrowed towel came back cleaner than when Oskar Pbscn lent it. He is considering lending out the rest of the washing.

Oskar Pbscn cut Marek Jackmdunn's hair with a bayonet and a cracked mirror. It is not good. It is, however, short. After the loss of Hill 304, Oskar Pbscn helped stack spare sandbags at S-F11. Nobody asked when they would be needed.
Oskar Pbscn pulled Wendel Yurboixav out of a flooded shell hole at the Chalk Pits. Neither has mentioned it since. Both remember.
Oskar Pbscn drew the street leading to Rosenau. There was no room left for the last house, so he turned the page over.
The trench wall shook against Oskar Pbscn's shoulder during the bombardment. He pressed both feet into the boards and waited for the next hit.
A parcel from home held a comb. Oskar Pbscn has hardly any hair left after the last haircut, but he appreciated the thought.
The Hegemony won Blackwater Canal. In S-F11, Oskar Pbscn listened to three explanations and trusted none of them.

Part of the parapet collapsed near Oskar Pbscn. Repairs started as soon as the dust settled, with one man on watch while the rest worked. The Hegemony hold Grey Mill now, and they can see straight into S-F11. Oskar Pbscn has learned to walk bent double.
The cook's stew tasted of iron and smoke. Oskar Pbscn ate two helpings anyway.
Oskar Pbscn can fall asleep anywhere, instantly. Today, under fire at Blackwater Canal, that habit was the only steady thing in S-F11.
Oskar Pbscn measured the remaining pencil against the remaining paper. For once, the supplies seemed likely to run out together.
The cook asked for an honest opinion of the stew. Oskar Pbscn asked if second helpings depended on the answer.

The men at S-F11 heard Oskar Pbscn call out once and then go quiet. They found him hit in the back, still holding the rifle. Shot by Hugo Klecka of the Hegemony (@klecka2617). Oskar Pbscn was hit at S-F11 and died before the medic arrived. The squad has kept his place on the fire step empty. Shot by Hugo Klecka of the Hegemony (@klecka2617).
Quentin "Doc" Pbscn put a key to a house that is no longer there beside the bunk. Someone who had known Oskar Pbscn helped clear the shelf without saying why.
riley_schaefer.2: They issued Cyril Schaefer a rifle, a spade and a number. He kept a pocket Bible with a hole in it in his breast pocket, where the shrapnel would have to go through it first.

Cyril Schaefer raised his head for a heartbeat too long at T-F23. The bullet only grazed him. He will not do it again. Shot by Zeno Thebaconnati of the Concord (@thebaconnation). Grey Mill is in Hegemony hands. Cyril Schaefer watched the map being corrected and wondered how such a small pencil mark could take so much work.
The wound on Cyril Schaefer's hand healed crooked, but it healed. He can hold a rifle and a mug, and those are the two things that matter.
Cyril Schaefer sharpened a pencil carefully and then could not think what to write. He put the date at the top anyway.
A round went through the rim of Cyril Schaefer's helmet and nicked his ear on the way out. He has a notch in both now. Shot by Zeno Thebaconnati of the Concord (@thebaconnation).
The medics cleaned Cyril Schaefer's wound one last time and pronounced him fit. He is back to full duty at T-F23.
A flare, boots, a short fight in the dark at T-F23. Cyril Schaefer was killed before the rest of the squad was even awake. Killed in the night raid by Henrik "Hollow" Elm of the Concord (@elm227987).
The papers say Viktor Schaefer. The sergeant says he has his brother's eyes. Cyril Schaefer's eyes. Nobody in T-F23 argues.
skylerb.317: Tobias Skylerb arrived on Day 7 and found the section asleep. The welcome had to wait until somebody needed the kettle.
Tobias Skylerb fired three short bursts at nothing to keep the enemy honest. The enemy fired three back to keep him honest too.
Tobias Skylerb owes Hugo Adamjedlicka so many cigarettes that they stopped counting and started writing it down. The notebook is nearly full.

A bullet hit Tobias Skylerb in the neck at R-S12. The medic kept two fingers pressed on the wound all the way down the trench. Shot by Cyril "Mole" Skies of the Hegemony (@beyond_dusky_skies). Tobias Skylerb was hit at R-S12 and died before the medic arrived. The squad has kept his place on the fire step empty. Shot by Cyril "Mole" Skies of the Hegemony (@beyond_dusky_skies).
Gustav Skylerb had heard about Tobias Skylerb's courage. At R-S12, he also heard about the snoring, the cards and the terrible handwriting.

A new trench junction cost Gustav Skylerb ten minutes. On the way back, he marked the right turn with a broken spoon. A thousand names now stand in the regimental book. Gustav Skylerb is number 476. The sergeant pinned the ribbon of the First Thousand on without a speech. Grey Mill fell to the Hegemony. Gustav Skylerb kept the newspaper; he wanted to remember exactly what had been promised beforehand.
Someone asked Gustav Skylerb to wake them in ten minutes. He had no watch, so he counted slowly and woke them at what felt like ten.
Tobias "Brick" Kevinkukhta lent Gustav Skylerb a pencil. It came back wrapped in a scrap of paper that said 'One good turn'.
Gustav Skylerb tried to write neatly for the first line of a letter. By the third, he was writing as quickly as the thoughts arrived.
Gustav Skylerb and Tobias "Brick" Kevinkukhta carved a chess set out of candle wax. The kings melted too close to the stove, so the game goes on without them.
A single shot from across the wire hit Gustav Skylerb in the thigh at R-S12. He crawled the last yards on his elbows. Shot by Wendel What of the Hegemony (@bro_what1472).
smokys_da_bear: Ulrich Bear came up on Day 10 carrying news from Old Harrow. A man interrupted to ask whether the railway clock had been repaired.

A bullet went through Ulrich Bear's sleeve at Q-F17 and took some skin with it. He kept the sleeve. Shot by Nils "Saint" Slevvinkilev of the Concord (@slevvinkilevra). Word came down the line: Grey Mill is ours. Ulrich Bear shook hands with a corporal he had never spoken to. Today, everyone was a friend.

Ulrich Bear was hit in the knee while crossing a low part of the trench at Q-F17. He will walk again, the medic thinks, but not soon. Shot by Karel Servantofgod of the Concord (@james_servantofgod). Ulrich Bear was killed outright at Q-F17, a single bullet from across the wire. Shot by Karel Servantofgod of the Concord (@james_servantofgod).
Clement "Bones" Bear joined Q-F17 under the shadow of Ulrich Bear's name. At the first roll call, the corporal used the right one.
Clement "Bones" Bear borrowed a book with three readers already waiting in line. For once, everyone was impatient about something harmless.

Clement "Bones" Bear reached up to fix a sandbag at Q-F17 and a bullet took the skin off two knuckles. The sandbag got fixed anyway. Shot by Nils "Saint" Slevvinkilev of the Concord (@slevvinkilevra).
The medic looked at Clement "Bones" Bear's wound, sniffed it, and sent him back to Q-F17. Clean, said the medic. It is the best word a medic knows.
A round went through the rim of Clement "Bones" Bear's helmet and nicked his ear on the way out. He has a notch in both now. Shot by Karel Servantofgod of the Concord (@james_servantofgod).
theophane_br: After 10 days of war, U-F1 had a place for everything. On Day 10, the men rearranged a shelf to make a place for Oskar "Bones" Theophane.

A round went through the rim of Oskar "Bones" Theophane's helmet and nicked his ear on the way out. He has a notch in both now. Shot by Pavel Viaenegilles of the Hegemony (@viaenegilles). Oskar "Bones" Theophane had marked the enemy's path to the latrine on a scrap of paper. Today it paid off: Leopold Zxburg, gravely wounded. Day 11. Grey Mill fell to the Hegemony. Oskar "Bones" Theophane watched their flag go up on the heights and dug his trench a little deeper.

A bullet went through Oskar "Bones" Theophane's upper arm at U-F1 and broke the bone. He held the arm across his chest and walked half the way back before his legs gave out. Shot by Benedikt Clintxix of the Hegemony (@clintxix).

Oskar "Bones" Theophane's wound turned bad. The bandage was not enough and he was carried back to wait for a bed. An orderly waved the bearers in: one bed, cleared and scrubbed. Oskar "Bones" Theophane was lifted onto it in the hospital dugout.
Oskar "Bones" Theophane is out of the worst of it. He sleeps most of the day, and the surgeon lets him.
Oskar "Bones" Theophane died on a stretcher outside the aid post, still waiting for a bed. The medics had nothing left to give him.
Silas "Whistle" Theophane joined U-F1 under the shadow of Oskar "Bones" Theophane's name. At the first roll call, the corporal used the right one.

The Hegemony sentry, Norbert "Rabbit" Mustakimabdu, shouted once. Silas "Whistle" Theophane silenced the shout with the flat of a shovel and was back over the parapet a minute later. (@mustakimabdulwahab93) Silas "Whistle" Theophane crawled through a gap in the Hegemony wire and slid into their trench. Cyril "Spark" Evader reached for a rifle. Silas "Whistle" Theophane was faster with the sharpened shovel. (@mr._tax_evader)
vl.tsanev: Clement Tsanev left his mother, who writes every Sunday behind in Lindenbruck and came up the line with a lock of hair in a matchbox. The men noticed at once that he keeps feeding the rats.
As one of the first hundred volunteers, Clement Tsanev received the First Wave ribbon. A neighbour lent the needle and supervised every stitch.
Clement Tsanev found water collecting beneath the gun's cover. He sketched a small shelter and took the drawing to the stores.

The stores supplied Clement Tsanev with shorter boards than requested. The gun shelter has become an exercise in joints and bad language. Verdel Ridge fell to the Concord at dusk. Clement Tsanev helped drag the guns up the slope and slept that night on ground nobody else had held for years.
Clement Tsanev finished the shelter. The crew tested every movement of the gun and discovered that the roof needed moving back a hand's width.
Clement Tsanev taught Emil Majormalprac to play the harmonica. The whole squad has asked them both, politely, to stop.

Clement Tsanev fired twice at the enemy post. The second shot found Walter Mat, badly wounded. Nobody nearby said anything. The Hegemony took Hill 304. Clement Tsanev watched the officer move a pin on the map and ask for more digging tools.
The altered shelter passed inspection. Clement Tsanev found the crew had added a tiny sign: 'No lodgers'. Someone had already left a blanket inside.
Clement Tsanev had been watching the same gap for an hour. When Bram "Ghost" Dravci crossed it, Clement Tsanev fired. Bram "Ghost" Dravci was badly wounded.

Clement Tsanev was hit through the stomach at S-F13. The bearers ran with the stretcher and did not stop to rest. Shot by Severin Heheheha of the Hegemony (@heheheha1939). At S-F13 the men had a bet on who would hit something first. Clement Tsanev won the bet. Severin Heheheha was grazed. Clement Tsanev was killed at S-F13 while passing a message along the trench. He never finished the sentence. Shot by Severin Heheheha of the Hegemony (@heheheha1939).

Pavel Tsanev had heard about Clement Tsanev's courage. At S-F13, he also heard about the snoring, the cards and the terrible handwriting. First Wave. Pavel Tsanev signed when the ink on the posters was still fresh. He keeps the ribbon wrapped in oilcloth with a lock of hair in a matchbox.
Pavel Tsanev took stock of his pockets: string, crumbs, a pencil and no sign of the button he was looking for.

The raid hit the Hegemony line at the darkest hour. Pavel Tsanev fought Emil Theramblingb in a trench no wider than a door. Pavel Tsanev came home with Emil Theramblingb's cap badge. (@theramblingbot) Pavel Tsanev jumped into the Hegemony trench and swung the shovel at the first shape that moved. It was Edmund Matteozrybak. The Hegemony medics will be busy. (@matteozrybak) On the way back from the night raid a flare went up. Pavel Tsanev was caught in the open and hit before reaching the wire. After the loss of Blackwater Canal, Pavel Tsanev helped stack spare sandbags at S-F13. Nobody asked when they would be needed.

A sniper's bullet hit Pavel Tsanev at S-F13. The medics worked on him in the bottom of the trench and shouted for a stretcher. Shot by Jonas "Ash" Tomar of the Hegemony (@agastya_singh_tomar_). An orderly waved the bearers in: one bed, cleared and scrubbed. Pavel Tsanev was lifted onto it in the hospital dugout. The worst has passed for Pavel Tsanev. The surgeon says he will live, though not quickly. Grey Mill fell to the Hegemony. Pavel Tsanev kept the newspaper; he wanted to remember exactly what had been promised beforehand.

Pavel Tsanev's wound turned bad. The bandage was not enough and he was carried back to wait for a bed. The orderlies scrubbed a bed in the hospital dugout and called for Pavel Tsanev. He was asleep before they set him down.
The man in the next bed snored all day. Pavel Tsanev did not mind. It meant someone was still breathing.
The medical officer cleared Pavel Tsanev for duty. At S-F13, someone quietly moved a pack off his usual seat.
Pavel Tsanev held the mirror while Jonas Raphoto shaved. The arrangement survived the shaving but not the comments.

A bullet hit the sandbag next to Pavel Tsanev's ear at S-F13 and sprayed his face with grit and blood. A scratch, the medic said, and a lucky one. Shot by Jonas "Ash" Tomar of the Hegemony (@agastya_singh_tomar_).
zonk3888: After 15 days of war, W-F9 had a place for everything. On Day 15, the men rearranged a shelf to make a place for Walter Zonk.
Someone asked Walter Zonk to wake them in ten minutes. He had no watch, so he counted slowly and woke them at what felt like ten.
